Front layer tagged 'h=1' (black oval, white text) is salmon; behind it h=2 lavender, h=3 yellow, h=4 light green, h=5 peach. Each visible top edge carries a gray 'Similarity' pill (left) and gray 'Weighted SUM' pill (right); each right edge shows a green-dashed container of white boxes with red 'X' letters plus a column of blue 'W^U' boxes. Partially occluded inner boxes of back layers peek out at top: a green-dashed [X] box (topmost, h=5 output), a solid green box below-left of it, and a dark maroon box (likely an inner W^q) [?].

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title: bold, ~26–30 px, two-color (red + dark navy) with a red subscript '2' on X. Diagram labels: ~9–13 px bold; pill texts ('Similarity', 'Weighted SUM', 'Probabilities') small bold dark-gray on light-gray pills. 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) in maroon on pink boxes. 'h=1'–'h=5' are white bold on black ovals. 'K·q/√d' is rendered as a stacked vertical fraction. '*H* Heads' is blue italic with literal asterisks around H. Slide number '15' is bold red on yellow. Box letters 'X' are red serif-less capitals; W-labels are white on colored boxes with superscripts.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all five head layers (h=1…h=5) are visible simultaneously, no mid-reveal bullets or builds. A live mouse cursor is visible near the upper 'Similarity' pills, indicating pointer movement during recording.
recreation_brief:
1. White 16:9 slide. Draw a no-fill rectangle border, 2.25 pt, #C00000, inset ~6% from all edges; inside it a second no-fill rectangle border, 1.5 pt, #0000CC, inset ~8%.
2. Top-right, overlapping the red border (~91% width, 14% height): 0.9 cm oval, fill #FFFF99, outline #C00000 1.5 pt, text '15' bold red ~14 pt.
3. Front layer h=1: rounded rectangle spanning ~12–66% width, ~30–80% height, fill #F08080, no line. On its top edge place gray (#D9D9D9) pills 'Similarity' (~27% width) and 'Weighted SUM' (~50% width), and a black oval 'h=1' with white bold text (~63% width).
4. Inside h=1, left→right: (a) orange #F5A050 ellipse (~12–19% width) with 4 rows of [white box, red 'X'] + [green #00B050 box, white 'W^V']; (b) green #6ABF6A ellipse with 4 small green key boxes; (c) gray rectangle 'Dot Product'; (d) four vertical thin lines with blue dots at crossings; (e) pink #DDA0DD vertical rounded rectangle with rotated maroon text 'Scaling by √d', plus label 'K·q' with a small arrow above it; (f) stacked fraction text 'K·q/√d'; (g) pink vertical rounded rectangle with rotated maroon text 'Soft max'; (h) gray pill 'Probabilities' above with a small green arrow; (i) white box, blue 1.5 pt outline, large blue 'Σ'; (j) four red ⊗ nodes (circle with X) cascading diagonally below Σ, each labeled V₁, V₂, V₃, V₄ with a small beige hatched box; (k) four blue #3333CC boxes 'W^U' (white text); (l) green-dashed rounded container with four white boxes bearing red 'X'. Connect with thin red lines: Soft max → each ⊗, ⊗ row → Σ → W^U → output X boxes.
5. Bottom of h=1: small text 'q₁' with a tiny hatched box; red #CC0000 box with white 'W^q'; below, a green-dashed rounded container with four white 'X' boxes, the 2nd filled #FF66CC with magenta dashed outline; small red arrow from lower-left pointing to the highlighted box.
6. Back layers: duplicate the h=1 group 4×; recolor fills h=2 #C9A8D8, h=3 #EDE87F, h=4 #C8E6B8, h=5 #F5CE9A; offset each copy ~4% width right and ~4% height up; send backward in z-order (h=5 deepest). On each copy keep only: 'Similarity' pill, 'Weighted SUM' pill, black oval 'h=2'…'h=5', and the right-edge columns of white 'X' boxes and blue 'W^U' boxes; delete occluded internals.
7. At the very top of the stack add small partially visible boxes: green-dashed [X] box (~63% width, 13% height), a solid green box just below-left, and a dark maroon box (~52% width, 24% height).
8. Gray plane: freeform parallelogram over the upper-left of the stack (~24–45% width, 14–38% height), fill #999999 at ~40% transparency, no outline.
9. Big arrow: thick curved block arrow #C00000 (~10 pt): tail at ~60% width/82% height, curving clockwise up the right side, head at ~83% width/43% height pointing up toward h=5. Add rotated text box along it: '*H* Heads', #0000CC, bold italic ~12 pt.
10. Four rectangles (~3% × 3.5% each), fill #CC0000, white bold text 'W^(1)', 'W^(2)', 'W^(3)', 'W^(4)', stacked vertically at ~63% width, 65–78% height.
11. Title bottom-center (~86% height), one bold line ~26 px: 'Multi Head ' in #CC0000 + 'Self Attention of Word ' in #1F3864 + 'X' in #CC0000 + '2' as a red subscript.
12. No photos anywhere; ignore the mouse cursor and the bottom black bar (both are video-recording artifacts, not slide content).
